title: Bootstrap supply-chain diagnosis in the original shared native context
acceptance_criteria: When bootstrap MV delivery fails in the original unfiltered shared-level context, what source offer and source/substation HV/MV components entered the actual solve, and what HV input reached that substation?
Does the fixture's powered APC control reflect external MV input or stored battery supply while its PA and emitters receive zero?

checks.rationale: Reproduce the bootstrap failure's original shared-level batching and competing power topology, not certify the sprint. Focused bootstrap diagnostics R18 and R22 passed without reproducing the full-run failure; R17/R21/R28 full runs failed it. Filtering changes that context. Run only this native check, with new solve-backed supply-chain diagnostics; no broad JVM/readiness/client reruns or owner approval. A passing run does not explain the intermittent failure.
